constraints.name: finance_payment_money_allocation_audit_actor_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (actor_id) REFERENCES user_profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: finance_payment_money_allocation_audit_allocation_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (allocation_id) REFERENCES finance_payment_money_allocations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

indexes.name: finance_payment_money_allocation_audit_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX finance_payment_money_allocation_audit_pkey ON public.finance_payment_money_allocation_audit USING btree (id)

indexes.name: money_allocation_audit_parent
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX money_allocation_audit_parent ON public.finance_payment_money_allocation_audit USING btree (allocation_id, created_at, id)

triggers.name: money_allocation_audit_immutable
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER money_allocation_audit_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.finance_payment_money_allocation_audit FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION money_allocation_immutable()

constraints.name: finance_payment_money_allocations_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['reviewed'::text, 'finalized'::text])) OR (reviewed_at IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: finance_payment_money_allocations_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'finalized'::text) OR ((status = 'superseded'::text) AND (finalized_at IS NOT NULL))) = (finalized_at IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: finance_payment_money_allocations_check4
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status = 'superseded'::text) = ((superseded_at IS NOT NULL) AND (superseded_by IS NOT NULL) AND (NULLIF(btrim(supersede_reason), ''::text) IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: finance_payment_money_allocations_created_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES user_profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: finance_payment_money_allocations_finalized_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (finalized_by) REFERENCES user_profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: finance_payment_money_allocations_payment_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (payment_id) REFERENCES finance_payments(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: finance_payment_money_allocations_previous_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (previous_id) REFERENCES finance_payment_money_allocations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: finance_payment_money_allocations_reviewed_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (reviewed_by) REFERENCES user_profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: finance_payment_money_allocations_superseded_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (superseded_by) REFERENCES user_profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

indexes.name: finance_payment_money_allocations_payment_id_revision_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX finance_payment_money_allocations_payment_id_revision_key ON public.finance_payment_money_allocations USING btree (payment_id, revision)

indexes.name: finance_payment_money_allocations_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX finance_payment_money_allocations_pkey ON public.finance_payment_money_allocations USING btree (id)

indexes.name: finance_payment_money_allocations_previous_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX finance_payment_money_allocations_previous_id_key ON public.finance_payment_money_allocations USING btree (previous_id)

indexes.name: money_allocation_current_payment
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX money_allocation_current_payment ON public.finance_payment_money_allocations USING btree (payment_id) WHERE (status <> 'superseded'::text)

triggers.name: money_allocation_immutable
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER money_allocation_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.finance_payment_money_allocations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION money_allocation_immutable()

triggers.name: money_allocation_integrity
triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER money_allocation_integrity AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.finance_payment_money_allocations DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_money_allocation()
